projects.title: É de Chão
projects.description: São Paulo café site with live menu, table reservations, and a full admin.
projects.longDescription: É de Chão is a production-style café product: public menu and story pages, São Paulo timezone open/closed status, a reservation flow validated with Zod, and an Auth.js admin for menu, hours, discounts, blog, and bookings. Built with Next.js, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Neon Postgres, and Drizzle — deployed on Vercel.

projects.title: VetPay
projects.description: Tele-vet product with client pets & bookings plus a role-based admin CRM.
projects.longDescription: VetPay is a tele-veterinary app with marketing pages, a client area for pets and appointments, and an admin CRM. NextAuth handles email/password and Google sign-in with role-aware redirects and ownership checks on server actions. Stack: Next.js, Tailwind, Neon, Drizzle, and Zod.

projects.title: Coming soon
projects.description: A small Stripe shop is next — catalog, cart, and Checkout for the portfolio.
projects.longDescription: Project three will be a compact commerce demo: seeded products, cart, Stripe Checkout, and a thin order admin. It’s scoped to show payments end-to-end without becoming another large CRUD app. Links will land here when the first version is live.

about.title: About
paragraphs: I'm a front-end developer building modern interfaces with React, Next.js, and Tailwind — from Figma layouts to UI in production. I like turning ideas into products that feel clear, fast, and good to use.

Before tech, I spent more than three years in restaurant and delivery operations: leading teams, customer service, sales, and training. That gave me pace under pressure, direct communication, and a business eye for what users (and the team) need day to day.
I want to grow in front-end on teams that value collaboration, quality, and continuous learning — and to ship well-made interfaces end to end.
